recap.text:
Newport Select Gold 14U Fall To Bellevue Select 8th
October 24, 2026 vs. Bellevue Select 8th
Newport Select Gold 14U couldn't keep up with Bellevue Select 8th, 50-27, on Saturday at Tahoma High School.
Aiden Ng was the top scorer for Newport Select Gold 14U with 16 points, but it wasn't enough to secure the win.
Leading 12-7, Bellevue Select 8th went on a 12-1 run to pull further away. Leading 39-25, Bellevue Select 8th went on an 11-point run to pull further away.
Newport Select Gold 14U controlled the third quarter, outscoring Bellevue Select 8th 15-11.
Ng hit two threes for Newport Select Gold 14U. Uttam Verriach (4 points), Deacon Chun (3 points), Mason Huang (2 points), Talen Tep (1 point), and Kalden Sen (1 point) also pitched in for Newport Select Gold 14U.
Bellevue Select 8th shot well from distance, going 7-19 from three. Bellevue Select 8th rebounded the ball well, collecting 37 rebounds.
Newport Select Gold 14U will travel to WR Sting for their next game on Saturday.
